text:
kelly: Heads-up — SilverLine requested a joint perf/W + throughput bench next sprint. Focus: kernel micro-tunes to lower tail latency and validated watt-per-token at chassis-level. Need owners and a light run matrix.

omar: I'm in. Minimal matrix: redwood-3b, redwood-7b; quants: fp16,int8; batches [1,4]; seqs [256,1024]; runs=3. Capture chassis_power_w, gpu_power_w, tokens_total, p95_ms, p99_ms.

lia: I'll own telemetry schema and the CSV/JSONL exports. Suggest columns: run_id,model,quant,batch,seq,avg_gpu_w,chassis_w,tokens_s,p95_ms,p99_ms,energy_j_per_token,peak_kv_bytes. Will push draft to the GH issue.

pete: I'll do the runbook and CI hooks. Standard run command to pin in runbook:

```
./sl-bench --model redwood-7b --batch 4 --seq 1024 --quant int8 --iters 3 --warmup 10 --chassis-measure --out s3://partners/silverline/3612340000/
```

marta: Legal note: SilverLine allows kernel tuning in their secure rack but kernel artifacts must not leave. They want a 1-page annex listing diffs and safe revert steps. I'll draft that.

bench-bot: Quick CI smoke: 3 runs attempted; 1 failed due to transient PDU timeout on chassis c7. Logs: s3://bench/silverline/3612340000/logs.tar.gz. Artifacts uploaded.

omar: For reliability add `--pdu-retry 5` and `--kv-flush` between iterations. Also log peak_kv_bytes so we can correlate OOMs.

lia: Will include `peak_kv_bytes` and `pdu_status` fields in the CSV. Prom labels plan: model,quant,batch,seq,lab,chassis,run_id. PromQL for energy per token (1m):

```
sum(rate(chassis_power_w[1m])) / sum(rate(tokens_total[1m]))
```

pete: I'll update the exporter to emit chassis_power_w and pdu_channel metrics and add a short troubleshooting section for PDU flakes. Opening PR with runbook + example commands.

marta: I'll circulate the annex template to SilverLine legal and request the two-week lab window. They also want a short tech note to include in partner docs.

kelly: Action items: lia telemetry schema (EOD), pete PR with runbook (today), omar add kv mitigation hooks (tomorrow), marta coordinate lab window (today). Weekly sync scheduled Friday 3612343600 to decide canary timing and marketing blurb.

bench-bot: Created GH issue #7111 "SilverLine chassis watt/token + kernel tuning" and linked CI artifacts. Calendar invite for weekly sync Friday 3612343600.

omar: :thumbsup: will follow up on OOM mitigations.

kelly: Thanks team — target: signed-off canary in partner rack and telemetry in S3 by end of the tuning window.
